core_obligations: Adjoint the functors (proof lines 11690-11694): by adjunction Hom_{D((O_U)_tau)}(epsilon^*K|_U, M|_U) = Hom_{D((O_U)_{tau'})}(K|_U, R epsilon_*M|_U).

Apply the comparison computation (proof lines 11695-11701): the left-hand side of the target identity is thereby identified with Hom of K into R epsilon_*M, which the no-topology computation evaluates as the derived Hom of the global sections; the identification R Gamma(U, M) = R Gamma(U, R epsilon_* M) by Leray gives the stated formula.
proof_roadmap: Move the comparison pullback to the other side by adjunction.
Apply the computation of Hom out of a quasi-coherent object and use Leray to rewrite the global sections of M.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes maps out of the pullback of a quasi-coherent object in the chaotic-topology comparison as the derived Hom of the global sections (statement lines 11677-11687). The proof (proof lines 11689-11701) moves the pullback to the other side by adjunction, applies the computation of Hom out of a quasi-coherent object, and rewrites the global sections of M by Leray. H2: one adjunction plus one application.
